failure_analysis.yaw_direction_structural_limit: of 269 validation yaw-teacher samples, EXACT_LOG_RESCAN (n=38, direction agreement 0.42) replays a fixed open-loop camera raster and REACQUIRE_SAME_TRUNK (n=16, agreement 0.06, 81 percent non-yaw predictions) turns toward a remembered bearing; both are invisible to a POV+previous-action student. When the student itself predicts a yaw action its direction agreement is 0.882, so the directional signal is learned; the strict 90 percent target is not reachable under the declared input boundary
failure_analysis.balanced_accuracy_structural_limit: validation successful-episode class counts include noop=2, backward=3, look_up=7, look_down=8, fine_look_up=10, fine_look_down=9; these rare classes dominate the balanced mean and several are teacher-internal (probe/noop) rather than pixel-determined

evaluation_runs.collector_smoke: logs/find_tree/natural_treechop_bc_v1_smoke_16850_2.summary.json (2 episodes, 1 success, 85 contact samples, NPZ/CSV/summary consistent, no cross-episode frames, clean Minecraft shutdown)

next_stage_recommendation: The offline gate thresholds exceed what the declared POV+previous-action boundary supports because roughly one fifth of teacher yaw actions come from open-loop scripts or remembered bearings. Passing would require either widening the student model input manifest (for example allowing the player's own F3 pose, which the runner already receives) or retargeting the yaw metric to samples where the action is pixel-determined; both changes need explicit authorization before any retraining.
